description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Pitipana South, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District (7840)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registrations and amendments under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple entries detailing specific amendments to land parcel titles, including changes to servitude rights, land extent measurements, Grama Niladhari divisions, cadastral map references, and property addresses. All content is focused on land and property-related administrative matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
